faqs.question: Can you redesign my existing website?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can review your current website, identify what is worth retaining, and scope the redesign around what needs to improve.

faqs.question: Who supplies the content?
faqs.answer: We agree on content responsibilities during scoping. Existing copy and images are a useful starting point; any additional content work is included explicitly in the proposal.

faqs.question: Can I update the website later?
faqs.answer: Yes. The handover approach depends on the agreed build. For a static JSON-driven site, content changes are made in its data files and then rebuilt and deployed.
